## Review checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the full diff, including AI-generated changes.
- [ ] Repository-authored text is English and `python Tools/check-language.py` passes.
- [ ] Inputs, execution consent and result semantics remain consistent with the contract.
- [ ] No secrets, personal configuration or unlicensed assets are included.
- [ ] I identified dependency, workflow, permission or publication changes for owner review.
- [ ] Actual tests and unverified claims are clearly distinguished.
